name: claude-workflow-kit
description: nil-park's personal Claude Code workflow skills, managed via GitOps.

plugins.name: workflow-core
plugins.description: Standalone, dev-environment-neutral skills: docs standards, code review, and a pre-push guard.

plugins.name: workflow-core-max
plugins.description: Parallel fan-out code review driven by specialized reviewer agents. Replaces workflow-core; don't enable both.

plugins.name: github-workflow
plugins.description: GitHub branch + PR workflow driven by the gh CLI. Depends on workflow-core.

plugins.name: gitlab-workflow
plugins.description: GitLab branch + MR workflow driven by the glab CLI. Depends on workflow-core.
